steps.priorities.intro: Switch on what else matters on this field. You can skip this.
steps.priorities.soilAlways: Soil health always counts. These add to it.
steps.priorities.water.hint: Prefer crops that need less rain or irrigation in dry years.
steps.priorities.forage.hint: Give weight to crops you can graze or cut for animals.
steps.priorities.nitrogen.hint: Prefer legumes that feed the next crop and need less fertilizer.
steps.priorities.erosion.hint: Keep the ground covered so rain and wind take less soil.
steps.priorities.organicMatter.hint: Leave more roots and residue in the soil each year.
steps.priorities.exclude.title: Crops you will not grow
steps.priorities.exclude.hint: Tick a crop to leave it out, for example if you lack the machines or a buyer.
steps.priorities.exclude.noField: Pick a field first to see its crops.
steps.priorities.exclude.otherCountry: Crop lists exist for the USA and Poland only, so there is nothing to leave out here.
